answer: Grow every identity as a tree in an orchard: it bears fruit only after established keepers graft it, and each keeper may graft just three newcomers per epoch, so endorsements are scarce and public. A graft carries liability - if the grafted tree cheats, the keeper's branch is pruned and its fruit forfeited. Each epoch, the keepers meet at a summit and audit a few trees, digging for roots buried in the dune of unverified claims; a fake root burns both tree and keeper. Forging a thousand faces means buying a thousand scarce, liable grafts from keepers who risk their own harvest.
